name: Replica Asset Image Generation
description: Extract target entities, design stable character visual identity, invoke model-specific image Prompt Skills, then render reference media.
when_to_use: Generate target character, scene, and prop reference assets from localized storyboard.
when_not_to_use: Do not use for source video understanding or video generation.

steps.title: 提取目标资产
steps.description: Collect referenced target characters, scenes and props.

steps.title: 角色视觉设计
steps.description: Execute character-visual-design before image model prompting to establish stable character identity.

steps.title: 生成图片模型专属提示词
steps.description: Route visual packets through selected image model Professional Prompt Skill.

steps.title: 生成真实资产图
steps.description: Render reference media from validated model prompts.

provider_rules: Character visual design must happen before model prompt compilation.
Model-specific Prompt Skills cannot invent identity facts.
Character generation keeps front master identity strategy and reference editing constraints.
Runtime cannot bypass Skill-authored prompts with raw entity text concatenation.
completion_criteria: Reference media is persisted and bound
failure_policy: Missing character visual design packet blocks character generation
